page_title: Server- Adding multiple streaming servers/storage servers
page_content:
#### 1. Functional Description

Add multiple streaming servers/storage servers

#### 2. Operating Instructions

Add multiple servers and add configurations to the GPSDaemon.ini configuration file under the CMSServerV6 file.
[COUNT]
gpsgatewaysvr = 2 (start 2 gateway servers)
gpsusersvr = 2 (start 2 user servers)
gpsmediasvr = 2 (start 2 streaming servers)
gpsStorageSvr = 2 (start 2 storage servers)
gpsdownsvr = 2 (start 2 download servers)
Start 2 storage servers as an example

2.1 configuration parameters

[COUNT]
gpsStorageSvr=2
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5853b62696113abf9886af48fe38997d)
After adding the above configuration to the GPSDaemon.ini configuration file, restart the server software.
After restarting the server software, you can see 2 storage servers on the server software console.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a45fbb06c2afaf29336f9fde4c5fcf77)
